summary: Iteration 9 — Fatura/Fiş Girişi (Phase 2, /fis-giris + POST /api/islem/fis-create). BACKEND: 9/9 pytest cases PASSED in 7.30s (/app/backend/tests/test_fis_giris_kuyrugu.py). Verified: happy-path POST /api/islem/fis-create with satis_faturasi + açık_hesap (2 satır: 2×15.50 + 1×20.00) returns {ok:true, id:int, durum:'bekliyor', geneltoplam:51.00} and persists via GET /api/islem/list?islem_grubu=fis with islem_turu=47, islem_turu_ad='Satış Faturası', kart_borclu_ad=cari_ad (borclu-taraf), tutar=51.00, detay parsed from detay_json with satirlar[2] + geneltoplam=51.00; nakit+kasa path returns geneltoplam=30.00; validation → empty satirlar (400 'En az bir ürün satırı gerekli'), invalid fis_tipi (400 'Geçersiz fiş tipi'), odeme_tipi='nakit' without kasa_id (400 'Nakit/Kart ödemede kasa seçimi zorunlu'), odeme_tipi='kart' without kasa_id (400), miktar=0 & fiyat=0 → geneltoplam=0 (400 'Fiş toplamı 0'dan büyük olmalı'); auth guard returns 403 without token; GET /api/islem/kasalar returns ok:true (list may be seeded). FRONTEND (390×844 web preview, direct nav to /fis-giris): header 'Fatura / Fiş Girişi' + back arrow render; all 4 type chips (Satış/Alış Faturası, Satış/Alış Fişi) present and selectable — active chip highlights with type-color; CARİ selector 'Cari seçin…' opens bottom sheet with title 'Cari Seç' + search input + loading spinner (cari-list fetch triggered — API returned 400 for empty tenant which is EXPECTED for the hotmail test account with tenants=[], not a fis-giris regression); ÜRÜNLER (0) counter + 'Ürün adı / barkod ara…' button opens 'Ürün Ara' sheet with search field + 'Arama yapın…' empty state, submitting 'kola' triggers stock-list POST (empty result for empty-tenant account — expected); barkod scan button visible (green icon) — scanner is device-only (skipped per review_request note); ÖDEME TİPİ segmented (Nakit/Kart/Açık Hesap) works, selecting Nakit reveals 'Kasa/Banka seçin…' selector, switching to Açık Hesap hides it; AÇIKLAMA input renders; GENEL TOPLAM ₺0,00 updates dynamically; 'Satış Faturası Kaydet' button uses tip.renk color and label changes with selected type; empty save (no cari) → red toast 'Cari seçin' (validation guard working). No red screen, no crash. Sheets use custom absoluteFillObject overlays (per review note — not React Native Modal, correct). GMAİL ACCOUNT LOGIN ISSUE: cakmak.ebubekir29@gmail.com / 123456 returned 401 both via /api/auth/login curl and via UI login — this is the only tenant-bearing account listed in test_credentials.md; hotmail admin (tenants=[]) was used for backend tests (tenant_id is passed via body, code path is fully exercised) and for frontend rendering checks. Happy-path E2E save-and-see-success-screen could not be exercised via UI because both test accounts either lack tenant (hotmail) or fail login (gmail); recommend main-agent re-seed / verify the gmail password.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/islem.py fis-create endpoint (lines 198-253): clean, parameterized SQL, validates fis_tipi/satirlar/kasa/toplam in the right order, computes geneltoplam server-side (source of truth), stores detay_json with satirlar & odeme_tipi & kasa. LGTM.
FIS_TIPLERI mapping (lines 121-126) matches ERP12 dökümü (47/45/71/69) and cari_taraf placement is correctly used in kart_borclu/kart_alacakli assignment.
/api/islem/list correctly parses detay_json into detay dict + pops the raw column — frontend can consume it directly.
/api/islem/kasalar merges dataset_cache blobs + manual kasa-ekle rows with a seen-set dedupe — good pattern for POS-basar data with fallback.

/app/frontend/app/fis-giris.tsx (470 lines): uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct), safe camera import (try/require + Platform check), useAuthStore.getState() for token in async handlers (avoids stale-closure). Uses custom overlay sheets (not RN Modal — complies with iOS ban). SafeAreaView(edges=['top']) + KeyboardAvoidingView present. FlatList used for large lists (cari/urun) with keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'. Ödeme validation happens client-side AND server-side. Good.

Minor: line 189 pdfYazdir template interpolates cari.ad / satir.ad directly into HTML without escaping — XSS risk is minimal (local Print.printAsync), but a tenant-supplied product name with '<script>' could execute in the print preview. Consider a tiny escape helper.
Minor: line 215 sends kasa_id=null when kasa is null; backend accepts Optional[int] so this is fine. odeme_tipi='acik_hesap' with no kasa_id is the default happy path — matches server contract.
No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-camera, expo-print, expo-sharing are all current 2026-07).
